answer: Each task is instantiated from a specified future drand quicknet round, domain-separating its threshold-BLS output into the challenge and binding responses to it through commit-reveal. Since the pulse is unknown at registration, sybil swarms cannot precompute answers or farm a reusable offline cache; they must do fresh work after the round. A whisper carried by zephyr across opal is no shortcut: beacon verification exposes replay or equivocation.
